Cloudflare counts page views when it serves an HTML page through the custom domain. The planner's internal tabs do not each count as a new page view. Unique visitor IPs are an estimate of people, not a person-level count; bots, shared networks, and changing IP addresses can affect it. Visits to the separate chatgpt.site address are outside these figures. Today is partial, and Cloudflare may report data with a delay.
